topic: Addressing problematic facility sensors and data
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on several problematic facility sensors, including one at PMG ZA CTIA (Domestic Departures) that has been offline since early December due to poor power supply. Another sensor location was questioned regarding its existence and naming conventions.

Later in the session, it was determined that a specific facility record did not exist, leading to suggestions of removing or 'pinning' the problematic entry. Finally, there was an update regarding PMG gaining access to RMC (Remote Monitoring System) and taking control of offline sensors. For sensors with poor data quality, follow-up information is pending from the team regarding whether changing the antenna location helped.
decisions: The problematic sensor at PMG ZA CTIA Domestic Departures needs investigation due to power supply issues.
A non-existent facility record was identified and agreed upon for removal/correction.
PMG gained access to RMC and will manage offline sensors.
action_items: [p4] to provide an update on the sensor changes by the end of the week.
Follow up on poor data quality sensors regarding antenna location change effectiveness.
